Hermes Bots is now **NexurBots**, made by NexurLabs. Same app, new name. Your settings, chats and bots carry over.

## Install

**One command** in PowerShell. It installs Hermes Agent too if it's missing, checks the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and opens the app:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or by hand:** download **`NexurBots-Setup-1.8.6.exe`** below and run it. It upgrades Hermes Bots 1.x in place. Check the download against **`SHA256SUMS.txt`** (PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\NexurBots-Setup-1.8.6.exe`).

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- No auto-update: install a newer `NexurBots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.
- **Needs Hermes Agent v0.22.3 or newer.**

## What changes with the new name

- The window, Start menu entry, Desktop shortcut and installer are called NexurBots. An old "Hermes Bots" Desktop shortcut that points at the old app is removed.
- Settings move from `%APPDATA%\Hermes Bots` to `%APPDATA%\NexurBots` the first time 1.8.6 starts. If an older copy is still running and holding the folder, the app keeps using the old folder instead, and nothing is lost.
- Upgrading over Hermes Bots replaces it: Windows lists one app, NexurBots, not two.
- Bots now see "NexurBots" in their app tools' descriptions. Their tools keep working, with the same names in Hermes as before.
- The repository is now [nexurlabs/nexur-bots](https://github.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots). Old `hermes-bots` links redirect.
